articles.title: Hacks of 2 federal agencies in a month have spilled a bonanza of sensitive data
articles.content: It has been a bad month for federal government cybersecurity.
articles.titleZh: 一个月内2个联邦机构的黑客攻击泄露了大量敏感数据
articles.contentZh: 对于联邦政府的网络安全来说，这是一个糟糕的月份。

articles.title: Memory executives expect RAM shortage to continue through 2028
articles.content: Prices for memory sold for 2027 "are much higher than 2026 prices."
articles.titleZh: 内存高管预计RAM短缺将持续到2028年
articles.contentZh: 2027年售出的内存价格“远高于2026年的价格。”

articles.title: Attackers have been exploiting critical Zimbra flaw to steal emails
articles.content: A simple email gives the attackers the ability to remotely inject OS commands.
articles.titleZh: 攻击者一直在利用Zimbra的关键漏洞窃取电子邮件
articles.contentZh: 一个简单的电子邮件使攻击者能够远程注入操作系统命令。

articles.title: Cloudflare plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates
articles.content: The move will be part of a major overhaul of the ecosystem for website authentication.
articles.titleZh: Cloudflare计划颁发量子安全TLS证书
articles.contentZh: 此举将是对网站身份验证生态系统进行重大改革的一部分。

articles.title: Apple’s reportedly developing a smart home camera that doesn’t record video
articles.content: Apple's rumored push into smart home tech could include a smart home security camera that only gives users text event descriptions instead of video footage. Mark Gurman said in the first episode of the Power On podcast that the camera will be part of "a new Apple smart home ecosystem," alongside Apple's rumored smart home […]
articles.titleZh: 据报道，苹果正在开发一种不录制视频的智能家居摄像头
articles.contentZh: 苹果公司对智能家居技术的传闻可能包括智能家居安全摄像头，该摄像头仅为用户提供文本事件描述，而不是视频片段。马克·古尔曼（ Mark Gurman ）在Power On播客的第一集中表示，该摄像头将与传闻中的苹果智能家居[…]一起成为“新的苹果智能家居生态系统”的一部分。

articles.title: Google’s new Guided Vision feature can help you read the fine print
articles.content: Guided Vision is launching in Gemini Live on compatible Android devices today to use AI to give real-time audio descriptions of anything you point your phone's camera at. By sharing your camera in Gemini Live, you can have Google's AI help with things like reading small text, describing your surroundings, finding or identifying objects around […]
articles.titleZh: 谷歌的新引导视觉功能可以帮助您阅读
articles.contentZh: Guided Vision今天在兼容的Android设备上推出Gemini Live ，使用人工智能为您对准手机摄像头的任何内容提供实时音频描述。通过在Gemini Live中共享相机，您可以让Google的人工智能帮助您阅读小文本、描述周围环境、查找或识别[…]周围的物体
